% ss_bind_good.tex — study-guide shaped document against ss_bind.json:
% worked examples live in examplebox environments (no \problem, no
% enumerate) with results printed via \ans{...} per the template. The
% examplebox fallback must segment it per worked example and PASS —
% this fixture guards the SKILL.md ss_ invocation of check_answer_key.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, mdframed, xcolor}
\newmdenv{examplebox}
\newcommand{\ans}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\begin{document}

\section*{Skills Summary}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} Factor $x^2 - 7x + 12$.\\
Two numbers that add to $-7$ and multiply to $12$: $-3$ and $-4$.\\
$\Rightarrow\quad x^2 - 7x + 12 = \ans{(x-3)(x-4)}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} Estimate $\sqrt{2}$ to two decimal places.\\
$\sqrt{2} \approx \ans{1.41}$
\end{examplebox}

\end{document}
